One-line roles only. Instruments and status live on [Official status](tracker.qmd) and [Timeline](dates.qmd); term definitions on the [Glossary](glossary.qmd). Comparators are not Hong Kong law.

## Standing caveats {#standing-caveats}

State these clearly here; earlier Orient pages only point back to this section.

1. **Regulatory Sandbox ≠ [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law).** They are different Hong Kong trial programmes. Do not blend their project counts or Advisory Circulars ([Official status](tracker.qmd)). Example: **AC-013** (BVLOS) belongs with the first Regulatory Sandbox; **AC-017** (cross-boundary) belongs with Sandbox X.
2. The Shenzhen–Hong Kong / GBA **cross-boundary corridor is not operational** on the evidence tracked on this site ([Official status](tracker.qmd); [Timeline](dates.qmd)). Policy aims or trial pathways are not the same as an operating corridor.
3. Related OPEN items students also mix up: **no published Action Plan text** yet; **no dedicated Hong Kong eVTOL or vertiport statute** yet ([Official status](tracker.qmd)).

## Hong Kong

| Body | What it controls for this course |
|------|----------------------------------|
| [**Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy**](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Cross-government LAE strategy group (headed by the Deputy Financial Secretary; STL is Deputy Head). Selects Sandbox / Sandbox X projects; Action Plan still being formulated (text **OPEN**). |
| [**TLB** (Transport and Logistics Bureau)](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Policy bureau: Working Group secretariat support; runs Sandbox pilot projects by batches; publishes Sandbox X module communications. |
| [**CAD** (Civil Aviation Department)](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Cap. **448G** SUA regulator; issues sandbox Advisory Circulars; designates restricted flying zones; technical study role on the planned traffic-management system. |
| [**OFCA / Communications Authority**](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) | Spectrum licensing for the **1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence** (confined to LAE Regulatory Sandbox projects). CAD still approves relevant flight paths in that setting. |

## Mainland (comparator)

| Body | What it controls for this course |
|------|----------------------------------|
| [**CAAC**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Civil Aviation Administration of China — responsible authority under **CCAR-92** for UAS operational safety; publisher of ATM Rules Ch. 12 **draft** (not promulgated). |
| [**Ministry of Transport**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Promulgated **CCAR-92** (MOT Order 2024 No. 1; in force 1 Jan 2024) — see Glossary diagram sources and [Official status](tracker.qmd). |
| [**NDRC**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Issued 发改低空〔2025〕**1676号** — **statistical classification** of 低空经济, not an official national scale (规模) figure ([Official status](tracker.qmd)). |
| [**Guangdong Provincial People’s Government General Office**](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators) | Issued 粤府办〔2024〕**6号** (LAE action plan 2024–2026); GBA corridor language is a **policy aim**, not evidence of an operating SZ–HK corridor ([Glossary](glossary.qmd#who-regulates-what); [Official status](tracker.qmd)). |

Related Mainland instruments (status on Official status / Timeline): **国令761**, National Airspace Basic Classification, Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision).

## EU / US (course comparators)

Not Hong Kong regulators. Use them for frameworks and readings, not HK compliance claims.

| Body | What students use it for here |
|------|-------------------------------|
| [**EASA**](glossary.qmd#eu-us-comparators) | EU Aviation Safety Agency — U-space framework as comparator; SC-VTOL / VTOL certification material; prototype vertiport design specs. Dated rows on [Timeline](dates.qmd); documents on [Readings](readings.qmd). |
| [**FAA**](glossary.qmd#eu-us-comparators) | US Federal Aviation Administration — UTM / UAM concepts of operations; Remote ID; powered-lift and AAM implementation plan as course comparators. Dated rows on [Timeline](dates.qmd); documents on [Readings](readings.qmd). |

[Course overview](overview.qmd) also names NASA, AiRMOUR, and other AAM frameworks as comparators — not decision-makers for Hong Kong flights.
